search_results.title: Reusable Rocket Completes Tenth Flight
search_results.snippet: A reusable first stage booster flew and landed for the tenth time, lowering the marginal cost of that vehicle's next several launches.

search_results.title: Small Launcher Startup Reaches Orbit On First Try
search_results.snippet: A small satellite launch startup reached orbit on its first attempt, a rare outcome for a new orbital rocket.

search_results.title: Space Agency Sets New Lunar Lander Date
search_results.snippet: A national space agency announced a revised target date for its next crewed lunar lander mission after a hardware review.

search_results.title: Satellite Constellation Adds Direct-To-Phone Service
search_results.snippet: A low earth orbit satellite constellation began offering direct-to-phone connectivity in areas with no ground cellular coverage.
